name: College of Swords
description: A legacy bard subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Defensive Flourish
grants.description: After a weapon hit made as part of the Attack action, expend and roll Bardic Inspiration. Add the roll to the hit's damage and to your AC until your next turn begins.

grants.name: Mobile Flourish
grants.description: After a weapon hit made as part of the Attack action, expend and roll Bardic Inspiration. Add the roll to the hit's damage, push the target 5 feet plus the number rolled, then optionally use your reaction to move up to your Speed into a space within 5 feet of it.

grants.name: Slashing Flourish
grants.description: After a weapon hit made as part of the Attack action, expend and roll Bardic Inspiration. The target and each other chosen creature within 5 feet of you take extra damage equal to the roll.

grants.name: Blade Flourish
grants.description: When you take the Attack action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that turn. Once per turn, a weapon hit from that action can use Defensive, Mobile, or Slashing Flourish.

grants.name: Bonus Proficiencies
grants.description: Gain proficiency with Medium Armor and Scimitars. A Simple or Martial melee weapon with which you are proficient can serve as a spellcasting focus for your Bard spells.

grants.name: Fighting Style
grants.description: Choose the Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting style. You cannot select a Fighting Style option more than once.

grants.name: Extra Attack
grants.description: You can attack twice whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

grants.name: Master's Flourish
grants.description: When you use a Blade Flourish, you can roll a d6 for the flourish instead of expending Bardic Inspiration.
